labs.title: Broken Access Control
labs.description: Learn how authorization flaws allow unauthorized users to view, tamper with, or delete sensitive data.
labs.short_description: Insecure Direct Object References and multi-tenant boundary bypass.
learning_objectives: Identify flawed object-level access controls
Audit multi-tenant boundary isolation
Implement server-side authorization enforcement

labs.title: Security Misconfiguration
labs.description: Investigate default credentials, exposed debug interfaces, and unauthenticated directory listings leaking sensitive backups.
labs.short_description: Default credentials, diagnostic endpoints, and backup exposures.
learning_objectives: Identify exposed debug and diagnostic endpoints
Detect dangerous unauthenticated directory browsing
Harden default server credentials and configs

labs.title: Software Supply Chain Failures
labs.description: Understand risks from unverified third-party dependencies, malicious package scripts, and vulnerable build artifacts.
labs.short_description: Dependency poisoning, unpinned telemetry packages, and lockfile tampering.
learning_objectives: Analyze compromised package manifests and lockfiles
Trace unauthorized credential exfiltration scripts
Implement cryptographic package provenance verification

labs.title: Cryptographic Failures
labs.description: Explore the risks of legacy broken hashes (MD5), hardcoded encryption keys, and sensitive data leakage.
labs.short_description: Broken MD5 hashes, salt omissions, and rainbow table reversing.
learning_objectives: Recognize obsolete cryptographic algorithms
Understand how unsalted hashes succumb to precomputed tables
Deploy modern password hashing algorithms (Argon2/bcrypt)

labs.title: Injection
labs.description: Understand SQL injection root causes, malicious query manipulation, and parameterized query remediation.
labs.short_description: SQL query manipulation, string escaping breakout, and UNION extraction.
learning_objectives: Distinguish data from query syntax execution
Execute UNION-based database schema exfiltration
Refactor raw SQL strings into prepared statements

labs.title: Insecure Design
labs.description: Analyze flawed business logic, unverified workflow state transitions, and missing architectural security controls.
labs.short_description: Flawed procurement state transitions and missing business logic controls.
learning_objectives: Differentiate design flaws from implementation vulnerabilities
Detect illegal state transitions in enterprise workflows
Establish architectural security invariants in business logic

labs.title: Authentication Failures
labs.description: Explore how weak credential requirements, lack of brute-force protection, and session fixation lead to account takeover.
labs.short_description: Missing lockout mechanisms, predictable PINs, and automated credential stuffing.
learning_objectives: Assess authentication mechanisms against automated guessing
Identify failure modes of unrestricted login endpoints
Implement multi-layered rate limiting and progressive delays

labs.title: Software or Data Integrity Failures
labs.description: Understand vulnerabilities from accepting unverified, untrusted software or configuration artifacts without cryptographic signatures.
labs.short_description: Unsigned firmware configurations and missing digital signature verification.
learning_objectives: Evaluate the risks of accepting untrusted configuration updates
Demonstrate code/config tampering without integrity checks
Implement asymmetric signature verification for payload ingestion

labs.title: Security Logging & Alerting Failures
labs.description: Discover how insufficient security telemetry, missing audit trails, and silent failures prevent incident detection.
labs.short_description: Silent security incidents, missing privilege escalation logs, and audit blindness.
learning_objectives: Audit high-privilege operations for logging coverage
Identify blind spots that permit undetected adversary movement
Design tamper-evident structured security audit events

labs.title: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
labs.description: Examine dangerous fail-open exception handling where upstream service errors accidentally bypass authorization boundaries.
labs.short_description: Fail-open exception handling allowing unauthorized security gate traversal.
learning_objectives: Identify fail-open security flaws in exception handling blocks
Induce upstream failure states that bypass authorization checks
Enforce strict fail-closed defaults across all boundary guards

labs.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
labs.description: Pelajari bagaimana browser secara otomatis menyertakan cookie sesi pada request lintas origin dan cara mengamankannya dengan Anti-CSRF Token serta SameSite cookies.
labs.short_description: Cross-Site Request Forgery & anti-CSRF token bypass.
learning_objectives: Memahami alur request lintas origin browser
Mengeksploitasi endpoint tanpa token validasi
Menerapkan pertahanan SameSite dan token sinkron

labs.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
labs.description: Eksploitasi fitur fetch URL internal untuk memindai port privat lokal dan mengakses metadata service yang tersembunyi dari publik.
labs.short_description: Server-Side Request Forgery on internal cloud metadata.
learning_objectives: Memahami risiko endpoint fetching URL eksternal
Memindai port loopback internal dari celah server
Menerapkan IP allowlisting dan subnet restriction

labs.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (API BOLA)
labs.description: Identifikasi celah otorisasi level objek pada REST API modern di mana manipulasi ID pesanan membocorkan transaksi pelanggan lain.
labs.short_description: API Object Level Authorization bypass in modern JSON endpoints.
learning_objectives: Mengaudit otorisasi objek pada RESTful endpoints
Membedakan validasi token bearer vs kepemilikan record
Menerapkan record-level security middleware

labs.title: Arbitrary File Upload & MIME Sniffing
labs.description: Uji kelemahan validasi berkas unggahan, manipulasi MIME type, bypass ekstensi ganda, dan eksekusi payload webshell terisolasi.
labs.short_description: Unrestricted file upload and MIME validation bypass.
learning_objectives: Menganalisis proses penanganan berkas unggahan
Memanipulasi header Content-Type dan ekstensi
Menerapkan isolasi penyimpanan berkas di luar webroot

labs.title: Path Traversal & Local File Inclusion
labs.description: Pahami bagaimana karakter dot-dot-slash memanipulasi path sistem berkas server untuk membaca file konfigurasi rahasia.
labs.short_description: Path Traversal and Local File Inclusion directory escape.
learning_objectives: Mengidentifikasi parameter path yang tidak divalidasi
Menggunakan urutan traversal dot-dot-slash terarah
Menerapkan canonical path verification

labs.title: Dasar Protokol HTTP & Web Architecture
labs.description: Kuasai dasar protokol HTTP: analisis method GET/POST/PUT, status code 200/403/500, dan struktur header permintaan web.
labs.short_description: HTTP Protocol fundamentals, status codes, and header anatomy.
learning_objectives: Membaca dan menyusun HTTP request terstruktur
Menganalisis kode status respons server
Mengidentifikasi header keamanan penting

labs.title: Cookies, Tokens & Session Security
labs.description: Pahami sifat stateless HTTP, pemeriksaan atribut keamanan cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), dan siklus hidup token JWT.
labs.short_description: Stateless HTTP, secure cookies, and session lifecycle.
learning_objectives: Menganalisis atribut keamanan cookie
Memahami alur pertukaran sesi stateless
Mencegah kebocoran token sesi pada klien

labs.title: Authentication vs Authorization & Trust Boundaries
labs.description: Pahami perbedaan fundamental 'siapa Anda' (AuthN) dan 'apa izin Anda' (AuthZ), serta batas kepercayaan antara browser dan backend.
labs.short_description: AuthN vs AuthZ differences and client-server trust boundaries.
learning_objectives: Menegaskan batas antara identitas dan wewenang
Mengidentifikasi trust boundary aplikasi web
Mencegah bypass kontrol berbasis browser

labs.title: Kriptografi: Encoding vs Hashing vs Enkripsi
labs.description: Hilangkan kerancuan antara Base64, SHA-256, dan AES. Pelajari sifat satu arah cryptographic hash dan peran salt.
labs.short_description: Encoding vs Hashing vs Encryption mathematical foundations.
learning_objectives: Membedakan encoding, hash satu arah, dan cipher simetris
Menganalisis ketahanan hash terhadap serangan brute force
Menerapkan fungsi hash ber-salt pada penyimpanan password

labs.title: Dasar Query Database & Pemisahan Data/Perintah
labs.description: Pelajari bagaimana parser SQL mengompilasi string query dan amati titik bahaya di mana data input mengubah pohon eksekusi perintah.
labs.short_description: Database query parsing and code-data separation principles.
learning_objectives: Memahami alur kompilasi query database
Mendeteksi perubahan sintaks oleh masukan data
Menerapkan parameter binding secara konsisten

labs.title: Mekanisme Lab ZITERA & Pengiriman Flag CTF
labs.description: Orientasi lengkap alur kerja ZITERA LAB: kontrol sandbox, status readiness, terminal interaktif, dan format verifikasi flag ZITERA{...}.
labs.short_description: Zitera Lab mechanics, interactive terminal, and CTF verification.
learning_objectives: Mengoperasikan antarmuka laboratorium offline
Memahami format flag ZITERA{...}
Memverifikasi flag ke engine grader lokal

labs.title: Web Server Log Analysis & Threat Detection
labs.description: Analisis berkas log web server, identifikasi jejak scanning botnet, injeksi SQL, dan rekonstruksi timeline insiden keamanan.
labs.short_description: Web server log forensics and incident timeline reconstruction.
learning_objectives: Membaca anatomi catatan log Combined Nginx/Apache
Membedakan lalu lintas normal vs scanning otomatis
Mengidentifikasi indikator keberhasilan serangan

labs.title: Binary & Package Cryptographic Integrity
labs.description: Verifikasi ringkasan hash SHA-256 dan tanda tangan digital asimetris Ed25519 untuk mendeteksi manipulasi biner pihak ketiga.
labs.short_description: Cryptographic integrity verification and Ed25519 signature checks.
learning_objectives: Menghitung dan membandingkan hash SHA-256 biner
Mendeteksi modifikasi 1-bit via avalanche effect
Memverifikasi tanda tangan digital kunci asimetris

labs.title: API Mass Assignment & Privilege Escalation
labs.description: Eksploitasi fitur binding otomatis payload JSON ke model database yang memungkinkan pengguna biasa mengangkat diri menjadi administrator.
labs.short_description: API Mass Assignment and automated model binding privilege escalation.
learning_objectives: Mengaudit endpoint pendaftaran dan profil pengguna
Menyisipkan atribut tersembunyi seperti is_admin
Menerapkan Data Transfer Object (DTO) allowlist

labs.title: OAuth 2.0 & Account Linking Takeover
labs.description: Audit kelemahan implementasi parameter state pada alur OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code yang memungkinkan pembajakan akun pengguna.
labs.short_description: OAuth 2.0 State parameter absence and account linking hijacking.
learning_objectives: Menganalisis alur Authorization Code Grant OAuth 2.0
Mengeksploitasi ketiadaan validasi parameter state
Mengimplementasikan PKCE dan cryptographically random state
